company.name: Cobalt Crew Recruitment
company.summary: You run Cobalt Crew Recruitment, a Manchester staffing agency. You place temporary warehouse and logistics workers with client sites across the North West. Your 35 person team handles recruiting, account management, compliance and weekly payroll.
offerings: Client account management for warehouse sites
company.customers: Warehouse operators, logistics companies, e-commerce fulfilment centres, manufacturers, distributors and third-party logistics providers in Manchester and the North West.

strategy.executive_summary: Cobalt Crew Recruitment places temp warehouse and logistics workers across Manchester and the North West. Your 35 person team is strong on relationships and client cover, but a lot of daily work still runs through manual checks, calls and spreadsheets. The best early wins are shift offers, timesheet chasing, candidate screening and right to work document checks. Start with agents that support your recruiters, payroll and compliance teams, and keep a human in charge of exceptions and final decisions.

maturity.label: Early
maturity.note: You have an ATS, recruitment CRM, payroll and scheduling tools, but the handoffs between them are mostly manual. A score of 2 means the foundations are there, but agents are not yet doing repeatable work.

opportunities.title: Shift offers sent to available temps automatically
opportunities.description: An agent checks the ATS and shift requirements for available, compliant temps, then sends personalised SMS or email offers. It collects yes or no replies, logs them in the ATS and flags anyone who has not responded.
before: Recruiter pulls a list of available temps for each open shift.
Recruiter calls or texts each temp one by one.
Recruiter waits for replies and updates the ATS by hand.
Recruiter repeats the same calls when someone drops out.
after: Agent checks ATS and shift requirements for available, compliant temps.
Agent sends personalised SMS or email offers and collects yes or no replies.
Agent logs replies in the ATS and flags no responses.
Human: calls only the non-responders and confirms final shift cover.

opportunities.title: Timesheet chasing and shift matching
opportunities.description: An agent compares shift bookings with submitted timesheets each morning, sends reminders to temps with missing or mismatched hours, and updates the payroll tracker. It lists exceptions for the payroll team to resolve before the weekly run.
before: Timesheet Clerk checks which temps have not submitted hours.
Clerk sends reminders by email or phone.
Administrator matches timesheets to shift bookings in a spreadsheet.
Administrator flags disputes and passes them to Payroll Manager.
after: Agent compares shift bookings with submitted timesheets each morning.
Agent sends reminders to temps with missing or mismatched hours.
Agent updates the payroll tracker and lists exceptions.
Human: resolves disputes and approves the weekly payroll run.

opportunities.title: Candidate screening for warehouse shifts
opportunities.description: An agent reads new CVs and ranks them against each client shift brief, checking location, shift pattern, licence and right to work status. It creates a shortlist in the ATS with reasons for each match so recruiters can approve who to call.
before: Recruiter opens each new CV in the ATS.
Recruiter checks warehouse experience, location, availability and right to work status.
Recruiter writes a shortlist in a spreadsheet or ATS note.
Senior Recruiter reviews shortlists for urgent shifts.
after: Agent reads new CVs and ranks them against each client shift brief.
Agent checks key facts such as location, shift pattern, licence and right to work status.
Agent creates a shortlist in the ATS with reasons for each match.
Human: reviews the top candidates and approves who to call.

opportunities.title: Client shift requests turned into confirmed bookings
opportunities.description: An agent reads client emails and extracts role, site, shift times, rates and numbers needed. It checks available and compliant temps in the ATS, creates the booking, sends confirmation and updates the CRM.
before: Client emails or calls with shift requests.
Coordinator writes the request into the CRM or a spreadsheet.
Coordinator checks available temps in the ATS.
Coordinator confirms booking by email and updates the client.
after: Agent reads client emails and extracts role, site, shift times, rates and numbers needed.
Agent checks available and compliant temps in the ATS.
Agent creates the booking, sends confirmation and updates the CRM.
Human: reviews gaps and calls the client if cover cannot be fully met.

opportunities.title: Right to work checks and expiry reminders
opportunities.description: An agent checks uploaded documents for missing pages, readable dates and key details, then extracts expiry dates and flags anything that needs a human check. It updates the compliance record and sends expiry reminders.
before: Administrator opens each uploaded passport, visa or share code.
Administrator checks dates, names and document type against client rules.
Administrator updates the compliance record.
Officer audits files and chases expiring documents.
after: Agent checks uploaded documents for missing pages, readable dates and key details.
Agent extracts expiry dates and flags anything that needs a human check.
Agent updates the compliance record and sends expiry reminders.
Human: reviews flagged exceptions and signs off the file.
tools: Right to work document checking tools

opportunities.title: Weekly client reports prepared from live data
opportunities.description: An agent pulls fill rates, attendance and no-shows from the ATS and time system, then builds the weekly report for each client site. It emails a draft to the Account Manager for review and context.
before: Coordinator exports fill rates and attendance from several systems.
Coordinator copies numbers into a weekly spreadsheet.
Account Manager checks the report and adds comments.
Coordinator emails the report to each client.
after: Agent pulls fill rates, attendance and no-shows from the ATS and time system.
Agent builds the weekly report for each client site.
Agent emails a draft to the Account Manager.
Human: reviews the draft, adds context and sends to the client.

opportunities.title: New starter pack and induction booking
opportunities.description: An agent sends the new starter pack and tracks what comes back, then chases missing ID, bank details and references on a schedule. It offers induction slots and books the chosen time.
before: Assistant sends a new starter pack by email.
Assistant waits for ID, bank details and references.
Assistant chases missing items one by one.
Assistant books an induction slot and updates records.
after: Agent sends the new starter pack and tracks what comes back.
Agent chases missing ID, bank details and references on a schedule.
Agent offers induction slots and books the chosen time.
Human: checks documents, answers questions and confirms the start.

opportunities.title: Common pay queries answered from payroll data
opportunities.description: An agent reads pay queries and looks up the temp record in payroll data. It answers common questions about pay date, rate, hours and deductions, then escalates anything about missing pay, tax codes or disputes.
before: Temp emails or calls about pay date, rate or hours.
Administrator looks up the record in payroll software.
Administrator replies with the same standard answers.
Manager handles complaints or complex queries.
after: Agent reads pay queries and looks up the temp record in payroll data.
Agent answers common questions about pay date, rate, hours and deductions.
Agent escalates anything about missing pay, tax codes or disputes.
Human: reviews escalations and replies to sensitive cases.

opportunities.title: Main phone triage and candidate arrival logging
opportunities.description: An agent answers common calls and routes urgent ones to the right person, logs candidate arrivals and sends a note to the recruiter. It takes messages and emails them to the team.
before: Receptionist answers every call.
Receptionist takes messages and passes them on.
Receptionist logs candidate arrivals on paper or screen.
Office Administrator handles supply and post queries.
after: Agent answers common calls and routes urgent ones to the right person.
Agent logs candidate arrivals and sends a note to the recruiter.
Agent takes messages and emails them to the team.
Human: handles complex calls, visitors and deliveries.

roadmap.title: Set up the highest volume agents
items: Map the ATS, payroll, scheduling and email data you already use.
Build the shift offer agent for SMS and email, with Recruiter approval.
Build the timesheet chasing agent and test it on one client site.
Agree human approval rules for compliance and payroll exceptions.

roadmap.title: Add compliance, onboarding and client reporting
items: Launch the right to work check assistant with Compliance Officer sign off.
Launch the new starter pack and induction booking agent.
Launch the weekly client report agent for your top five client sites.
Train recruiters and administrators on what the agents do and when to step in.

roadmap.title: Extend to client requests, pay queries and phone triage
items: Connect client shift request emails to the booking agent.
Add the common pay query agent for payroll inboxes and calls.
Add phone triage and candidate arrival logging at reception.
Review fill rates, payroll cut off times and query response times each month.

risks.risk: Right to work and candidate data is sensitive. If an agent handles documents badly, you risk a data breach or compliance failure.
risks.mitigation: Keep documents in your existing secure systems, limit agent access to the fields it needs, and have Compliance Officers approve all exceptions.

risks.risk: Automated shift offers or reminders may annoy temps if they are too frequent or poorly timed.
risks.mitigation: Set clear send times, opt out rules and daily caps. Let temps reply in plain language.

risks.risk: A screening or matching agent could put forward the wrong candidate.
risks.mitigation: Use agents to rank and prepare shortlists, not to make final hiring decisions. Senior Recruiters approve every candidate before a shift offer.

risks.risk: Payroll errors are costly and damage trust.
risks.mitigation: Keep Payroll Manager sign off for every weekly run. The agent only prepares matches and flags exceptions.

risks.risk: Your systems may not connect cleanly.
risks.mitigation: Start with email, SMS and spreadsheet outputs, then connect the ATS, payroll and scheduling tools in phases.
